tests.name: Research URI scheme generates deterministic, reversible OpenViking URIs
Derived context layers (L0, L1, L2) preserve canonical trace metadata
Staleness detection identifies source hash and derivation version mismatches
Adapter indexes, reads, retrieves, and queries research context progressively
Exact Fallback: Missing, stale, or unavailable OpenViking falls back to exact KAD source retrieval
Rebuildability: Deleting derived OpenViking context leaves canonical corpus intact and supports full rebuild
Canonical Authority Isolation: OpenViking derived context has authority: false and cannot mutate corpus
Baseline suite runs offline with zero external LLM or paid services
